scenes.text: Welcome to Livaware NurseOnboard. Sign in with your magic link or with Microsoft three sixty five, and your personal portal will open straight to your onboarding hub.

First, compliance. Upload your N M C pin, your D B S, your passport and your certificates. Our A I screens each document in seconds, flags anything missing, and files the verified copies straight to SharePoint.
Next, your competency declarations. Confirm the clinical skills you can safely practise, and we'll automatically email two of your professional referees on your behalf.

Then it's the Clinical Skills Arcade. Work through interactive scenarios and pick up a score. If you slip below the pass mark, a trainer reviews your answers, leaves remediation notes, and unlocks a focused retake just for you.

Once you're cleared, your availability calendar opens. Left-click to paint Day or Night shifts. Right-click any cell for the status menu — available, unavailable, or booked. Built-in safety checks warn you about double shifts and rest periods.

When you've worked, submit your timesheet from the portal. A P D F invoice is generated and emailed to our accounts team automatically. Once approved, you can re-download the P D F from your portal at any time.
That's your Livaware journey, end to end — compliance, competency, arcade, availability and invoicing, all in one calm portal. Welcome aboard.
